description:
Resolve posture defaults refined by a caller-supplied project fingerprint (or raw filePaths/packageJson inputs) and optional lint outcomes. Non-code projects lose code-analysis tool suggestions; the lint gate decision is surfaced so hosts apply lint verification only when the project opted in. Tier designations and manifest tool ids only — never provider/model names. Throws UnknownPosture for unrecognised posture names.

Free: does not call an AI provider.
name: refinePostureDefaultsForProject
